dataset: Agmarknet monthly mandi price & arrivals panel (curated extract)

source.originalSource: Agmarknet 2.0 API (api.agmarknet.gov.in), Directorate of Marketing & Inspection, Govt. of India

extract.selectionRule: Round-robin over the requested commodities; for each, the market series with the most complete monthly coverage in the window, preferring a state not already used for that commodity. Series are taken whole until the row budget is spent.

fields.state_name: State (derived from the Agmarknet state_id; upstream state_name column is empty)
fields.market_name: Mandi / APMC market name as listed on Agmarknet
fields.district: District of the mandi (blank where upstream could not match the mandi to the eNAM directory)
fields.arrivals_mt: Total arrivals that month, metric tonnes
fields.modal_price_avg: Modal price, Rs/quintal — midpoint of the arrival-weighted monthly min and max averages (see note below)
fields.min_price_avg: Arrival-weighted monthly average of the daily minimum price, Rs/quintal
fields.max_price_avg: Arrival-weighted monthly average of the daily maximum price, Rs/quintal
fields.n_obs: Number of daily observations behind that month
fields.mandi_id: eNAM mandi id where upstream matched the market, else blank

notes: Every row is real observed Agmarknet data. No values are simulated, interpolated or randomly generated.

The upstream repository publishes the min/max band panel but keeps the modal-price panel out of git, so modal_price_avg here is the midpoint of that band. Validated against the district-level modal means the same repo does publish (across_mandi_district.csv): r = 0.94 over 16,092 overlapping district-months, median absolute deviation 8.7%.
Re-run scripts/build-agmarknet-sample.mjs to regenerate or widen the extract.
